headline: Iran strongly condemns Israeli military attacks in south Lebanon as ceasefire violation
label: NEWS
caption:
Iran is backing Lebanon and condemning recent Israeli attacks in the south of the country. 🇱🇧

According to the Iranian Foreign Ministry, the aggressive actions coincide with Lebanon independence commemorations and violate the United Nations Charter and the November 2024 ceasefire agreement.

The ministry stated that the actions constitute a flagrant violation and underscore that the enemy represents the gravest threat to regional security and stability.

Iran also expressed support for Lebanon and its inherent right to defend its territorial integrity and national sovereignty.
